answer: Clawback windows: payouts vest over 90 days, revocable if a peer jury flags collusion. Each identity must lock a bond on the ridge before claiming rewards. A comet of withdrawals triggers review once velocity spikes. Sable operators farming n identities face n bonds slashed simultaneously on a single upheld challenge, so marginal cost per fake identity exceeds expected yield around identity five. Vesting delay forces attackers to finance float they cannot recover. This works because time-locked, slashable capital makes sybil scale economically negative before it becomes profitable.
